verses.text: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
lines: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice,
and my cries for mercy.

verses.text: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
lines: Because he has turned his ear to me,
therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

verses.text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
lines: The cords of death surrounded me,
the pains of Sheol got a hold of me.
I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.text: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
lines: Then I called on Yahweh’s name:
“Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

verses.text: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
lines: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous.
Yes, our God is merciful.

verses.text: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
lines: Yahweh preserves the simple.
I was brought low, and he saved me.

verses.text: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
lines: Return to your rest, my soul,
for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

verses.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
lines: For you have delivered my soul from death,
my eyes from tears,
and my feet from falling.

verses.text: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
lines: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

verses.text: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
lines: I believed, therefore I said,
“I was greatly afflicted.”

verses.text: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
lines: I said in my haste,
“All people are liars.”

verses.text: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
lines: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

verses.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
lines: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

verses.text: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
lines: I will pay my vows to Yahweh,
yes, in the presence of all his people.

verses.text: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.
lines: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.

verses.text: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
lines: Yahweh, truly I am your servant.
I am your servant, the son of your servant girl.
You have freed me from my chains.

verses.text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
lines: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving,
and will call on Yahweh’s name.

verses.text: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
lines: I will pay my vows to Yahweh,
yes, in the presence of all his people,

verses.text: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
lines: in the courts of Yahweh’s house,
in the middle of you, Jerusalem.
Praise Yah!
